text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Incoming request, divine steeds! 
You've been summoned!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As preparations for the Goshiki Shuntaisai 
continued... 
Yukino Bijin and the other four divine 
steeds received an invitation 
to make a guest appearance at a festival 
in Morioka!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know that festival! 
It's tied to the Shuntaisai, 
and all kinds of guests come every year!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And this year they want Maya and the 
gang~? 
Yaaay! Road trip, road trip! 
Let's do our best, everyone♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a mini-live scheduled for the 
festival, 
dance rehearsals got underway immediately. 
And then...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Whaa?! I'm the center?! 
A-Are you sure that's okay?
choice_data_list:
The organizers specifically requested you, 
actually.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(I'm mighty grateful, I really am. 
Is this thanks to that 'Snow Angel' 
craze...?)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
All right... a boom is my chance! 
I'm gonna give it every last ounce of grit 
I've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then came the day of the festival... 
The Morioka event plaza was packed to the 
brim.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Now then, allow me to introduce them! 
The divine steeds of the Goshiki 
Shuntaisai! 
And among their ranks is none other than—!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
The pride of Morioka! 
Yukino Bijin herself! 
Let's give them all a massive round of 
applause~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text:
"Wooooow!! She's the real deal~!" 
"Amazing! So coooool!!" 
"Your sprint in the Oaks was incredible~!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
('Cool'? 'Sprint'...?  
Not 'cute'...?! )

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yukki's super popular~☆

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Why is that...? 
Goodness gracious, this feels completely 
different than usual~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Not why, silly! It's your hometown! 
They've all been watching you closely♪ 
You copy?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin had charged through the Tiara 
campaign. 
Her earnest running had clearly struck a 
deep chord 
with the folks back home.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, it's almost time for the talk show! 
Let's go! Takeooooff☆

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
And now, time for our Q&A session! 
Look at all those hands going up~♪ 
Yes, the young horsegirl right over there—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Not just hype... they've really been 
watching me...? 
The folks of Morioka... looking at me...)

text_block_list.name: Morioka Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Um, I run in races too, 
and I really wanna try out for the Tracen 
Academy entrance exams...! 
Please give me some 'ad-vice'!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Gasp...! 
From Morioka to the Central turf, you say? 
You too...?

text_block_list.name: Morioka Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Well... even with everyone fussin' about 
how cute you are, 
you never stopped your gritty runnin', and 
I love that about you, Miss Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Morioka Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Your guts to head to the big city for your 
dream, 
how honest you are... I admire every bit 
of it! 
I wanna grow up to be just like you, Miss 
Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
'Just like me'...?  
Naw... it's not like I'm her or 
anything...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still... 
This girl's been watching me. 
And knowing all that, she looks up to 
me............

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (Tr-Trainer...!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Um...!  
I bet you're feelin' plenty of worries, 
but either way, you just gotta give it a 
shot...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If you've got dreams and folks you look up 
to... 
be true to yourself and reach for 'em. 
Even if people don't see it right away...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna keep workin' hard too! 
One day, I'll show everyone in Morioka 
what a true, legendary horsegirl looks 
like!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(A star... the star of Morioka... 
Everyone's hopes... that girl's dreams...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(And the me... I want to become! 
I'm gonna make it all come true...!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (That's what a real 'city girl' does!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin delivered 
a magnificent, commanding performance. 
Basked in the roaring cheers of the 
crowd...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—Phew! 
Thank you all ever so much~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The festival was an overwhelming success! 
On the bullet train ride home, 
Yukino Bijin looked a little spaced out, 
as if all her tension had melted away.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... 
Did I do a good job being a 'city girl'?
choice_data_list: Yeah, you looked really cool out there!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, thank goodness. 
Truth be told, between you and me, 
I was wound up tighter'n a drum...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Gotta keep my feet planted firm. 
After all... I'm someone people look up to 
now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before long, she drifted off to sleep. 
She must have poured everything into 
today... 
"Great job," I whispered softly once more.
